decisions.spectra_control_2026-10-05: Option 5 (downsized matched pair, repeated draws) goes to PHASE 2 via F102, NOT to Phase 1. The frozen PREREGISTRATION.md is not edited and carries no appended amendment: section 11 forbids an amendment that changes a gate pass/fail criterion, and H5(ii) rate-matched control IS that criterion. Phase 1 B4 runs the 10 feasible fits; energy_steel is reported unscoreable, which is an outcome the gate table already has a column for.

decisions.phase2_prereg: F102 may be drafted now and revised until its November filing; it binds only from filing. Option 5 is specification there, not an amendment.
